notes.title: 0.4.1 Patch Notes - New Map Hazard
notes.content:
New Map Hazard for all maps.

Void Rifts
A Void Rift portal will spawn on the map from time to time. 
If the player gets near it, you will have blurred vision as if it was 'tainting' you.

Bug Fix:
Fixed Bloodmark Tower map events not spawning on the map.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.0.1 - Bug Fixes + Adjustments
notes.content:
Patch 0.4.0.1:

-There are now 2 clipboard pages on the map at a time instead of 1.
-Slightly increased the enemy detection radius .
-Added some damage to the fire in Market Town.
-Slightly lowered the radius of the heartbeat starting point.
-Increased the xp rate from handing in clipboard pages from 1 to 5.
-The flaregun now spawns in a set location instead of a randomized spawn.
-The exit should be somewhat lit upon flaregun fire.

-Fixed the syncing of generator light and lights on map on Market Town.
